<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-INS-004</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Installation and upgrade</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>Platform Manager **System check**</b></div></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Build NNNNN; WSL2 needs Windows 10 2004 (19041) or newer.</span></div>

## Why it happens

On Windows, ClickHouse runs inside WSL2. WSL2 needs Windows 10 version 2004 or later and CPU virtualization (Intel VT-x, AMD-V / SVM) switched on in the BIOS or UEFI. A BIOS update can switch virtualization off again.

## Fix it

- Switch on virtualization in the BIOS or UEFI settings, then run the check again.
- Update Windows to version 2004 or later.
- Or choose PostgreSQL without ClickHouse, which needs neither.

## Check that it worked

The **System check** shows **CPU virtualization** and **Windows version** as passed.
